notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
You've slept with Santa, seduced Sexy President, and (possibly) shot yourself into space: [i]now it's time to journey back to where it all began.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699087/ed8a538719d79dcec99e1d42fd264db20daf855e.png[/img]

The [b]International Affairs Anniversary Update [/b]tweaks the entire first act of the game, rearranging and streamlining certain chapters, while eliminating and replacing others in order to make the experience faster paced and more accessible for everyone.

Several background illustrations and CG's have also been improved upon or replaced in order to further polish the game, along with updated character art and musical cues.

notes.title: International Affairs Sequel OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]A Fanciful Romance Set in the World of Tomorrow![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699087/c602138675e93d9e1b88de74b97d9c8ce21d9205.png[/img]

The year is 2025, and American President Jessica Lincolni is thicc as hell. You’ve got a major crush on her, and she’s just been dumped by your arch-rival (Macaroon's twin brother, the King of France)— sounds like the perfect opportunity to swoop in and pick up the shattered pieces of her broken heart, right?

WRONG, she’s still in love with him, dummy! But when she decides to fake a relationship with you in order to make him jealous, you’ll be given the chance to turn her counterfeit love genuine and win her heart for real.

It’s a fine line between playacting and romance, and you'll need the wise council of your friends if you want to succeed.  That's right, The Boys are back, only this time you'll be interacting with them face to face,  Pickup helpful tips, tricks, and techniques from Marty, Scooter, and beloved former protagonist Larry Lopez!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137620/Sexy_President/][h1]Hurry, a world of fantasy and adventure with Sexy President awaits![/h1][/url]

notes.title: The Celebration Update Has Gone Live!
notes.notes:
Very excited to share our latest update ahead of our upcoming four month anniversary.  This is a moderately sized patch mostly focused on streamlining the opening half hour or so of the game, plus a few new & improved CG's, dialogue changes, and other goodies, the full list of which you can read below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34699087/77490a18e793b8543d077d85075d184263df99fd.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new CG's to Drumpf's storyline, replacing several that I was unhappy with in the initial release.
[*] Streamlined opening half hour or so of the game, cut back on extraneous text, and added a few Easter eggs.
[*] Several small changes made to Drumpf storylines ending, with some new dialogue added, and outdated text replaced.
[*] Improved background art for Jersey International Airport.
[*] Laid groundwork for a potential gallery feature, if that's something folks are interested in for the future.
[*] Fixed several small bugs in Macron Storyline.
[/list]
